verdict.rationale: Gazebo Fuel is documented as a registry/ecosystem from which developers can pull ready-made robot models (PR2, TurtleBot, etc.) and physically accurate environment models, and the docs show copying SDF snippets directly from a model's Fuel page into a project; plugins extend hardware/behavior reuse further. missing for 10: no evidence of versioning/dependency management, search/discovery tooling details, or independent hands-on corroboration of the Fuel registry experience.
